summary: Rentokil Initial plc filed a Form 6-K announcing the pence sterling amount of its final dividend for fiscal year 2025. The dividend is 8.24 cents per ordinary share, converted to 6.10 pence using a GBP/USD exchange rate of 1.3513. Subject to shareholder approval at the AGM on 7 May 2026, payment will be made on 18 May 2026 to shareholders of record as of 10 April 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration and AGM notice with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring.
